economy: US dollar 103.85 (-0.40% today, -0.04% this week): a weaker dollar usually helps gold.
US 10-year yield 4.90% (-14 bp today): falling yields usually support gold.
VIX (fear index) 26.4 (-16% today) · S&P 500 -0.47%: fear is high: safe-haven demand often supports gold.
Gold is moving against the dollar and yields today: that move is driven by something else (flows, safe-haven demand) and can reverse.
Core PCE Price Index m/m at 20:30 GMT+7: Inflation data. Hotter than forecast → the Fed stays strict → yields and the dollar rise → gold usually falls. Cooler → gold usually rises.
Prelim GDP q/q at 20:30 GMT+7: Economic growth (GDP). Stronger than forecast → dollar up → gold usually falls.
history_note: Levels like this held about half the time over 2 years of data, so this is a place to watch, not a trade on its own.
